audience: documentation teams who publish their docs and help centers in GitBook

useCases.title: List our organizations, spaces and collections
useCases.text: Lists the organizations you belong to, the spaces in an organization and its collections, so you can see how the documentation is organized.

useCases.title: Search the docs for a topic
useCases.text: Runs a full-text search across one space or a whole organization and lists the matching pages for a topic such as refund policy.

useCases.title: Read a page and summarize it
useCases.text: Lists a space's pages with their hierarchy, opens a page by id and reads its content, so you can summarize it or look for gaps.

useCases.title: Review the change requests of a space
useCases.text: Lists the change requests of a space, so you can see which edits are in progress and summarize them.

useCases.title: Read the comments posted on a space
useCases.text: Lists the top-level comments on a space, so you can group the feedback readers have left.

useCases.title: Create or update a draft change request
useCases.text: Creates a draft change request in a space, which publishes nothing, or changes the subject or status of an existing one.
